pages.title: 국민안전24 | 민방위 | 교육일정

observation.method: Fresh anonymous Playwright Chromium read-only navigation; human review of visible public control text, safe fixed attributes, raw/resolved hrefs, inline onclick presence, ancestor/landmark context and original-page screenshot. No classifier, ranker or evaluation result was read or executed during blind-v2 collection.
conditions: 1440x1080 desktop viewport; source controls had layout boxes and were not CSS-hidden, inert or aria-hidden. Below-fold visible controls remain eligible.
No login, text entry, option selection, search submission, download, authentication or application event was executed.
Task-source focus/hit-testing and public destination checks, when performed, are recorded separately in docs/evidence/run002/blind-v2-observations.json.
limitations: Small reconstructed public-menu subset; not the complete live DOM, layout, application events, browser-extension execution, full accessibility audit or user study.

Original raw href attributes, including fragments and JavaScript URL text, are retained without script implementations. Inline onclick presence is represented only by an inert local onclick="return false" marker.

Only observed real semantic ancestors/headings are reconstructed; omitted unrelated ancestors, images and option contents may still affect live-page detection. Original div-based regions are not upgraded to artificial landmarks.
Readonly focus/hit-testing is not a screen-reader test or a complete keyboard-Tab-path audit. No original task action is automatically executed.

task.instruction: 교육일정의 검색 원본 버튼 위치를 찾으세요. 날짜·지역 선택이나 검색 실행은 하지 않습니다.
task.boundary: public link or original control reach only; no form submit

notes: 일정 조회의 원본 검색 제어와 담당부서 안내를 별개의 핵심 목적 기능으로 정했다.
입력값은 관찰·복사하지 않았다. 공개 고정 aria-label/title/placeholder만 보존하고 지역 select는 관찰된 첫 기본 option만 축약 재현했다.
